description: Supplier Statement vs Internal Ledger Book Reconciliation Process

supplier_statement.header_description: Date, Supplier Name, InvoiceNumber, Amount, Currency, Status

ledger_book.header_description: Date, ReferenceNumber, SupplierName, InvoiceNumber, Amount, Status, Notes

match_key.description: Unique identifier for each invoice record in both sources

comparison_fields.description: Account amount to compare between sources (Currency not compared as all samples are GBP)

source_of_truth.description: Both sources are peer documents. Report records missing from either side and report differences in compared fields.

reconciliation_rules.description: Identify records from both sources using InvoiceNumber as the unique key
Compare Amount values numerically, allowing difference up to 0.01
Report InvoiceNumbers present in only one source (missing from other)
Report records where Amount differs between sources (difference > 0.01 tolerance)
